name: Mapbox location search
manualSteps: Restrict the public Mapbox token to the application's development and production URLs.
Use country='gh' only when results must be Ghana-only; omit it when Ghana should merely be the initial bias.
Persist longitude before latitude and let the user confirm the selected place.
